This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Amounts are stored as integers in minor units, which avoids floating point errors. This is shown by IncomingTransaction.amount being a number for integer minor units in src/types.ts and by the transactions table storing amount as bigint. This also supports currencies like yen that do not use fractional cents.
